title: Modular data center maker Armada raised a $230M Series B co-led by Overmatch, 8090 Industries, and BlackRock at a $2B valuation, and plans a new Arizona factory (Krysta Escobar/CNBC)
summary: Krysta Escobar / CNBC: Modular data center maker Armada raised a $230M Series B co-led by Overmatch, 8090 Industries, and BlackRock at a $2B valuation, and plans a new Arizona factory — Armada, which builds modular data centers that are becoming increasingly popular with customers in defense, energy and the military sector …
